title: Supplier Service Fee by Plan — Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas
content:
Every Commercial Natural Gas Supply plan carries a flat supplier service fee billed per site for each billing cycle. Some plans also provide a dual-commodity waiver, under which the fee is not billed for a cycle in which the same site holds an active Beacon Ridge business electricity agreement or commercial and industrial contract.

| Plan | Supplier service fee per site per billing cycle (USD) | Dual-commodity fee waiver |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | 19.95 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | 14.95 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | 14.95 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | 14.95 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | 9.95 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | 19.95 | Yes |

## Notes on the table

- The fee is a per-site amount. A business with several sites on Commercial Natural Gas Supply is billed the fee of each site's own plan, cycle by cycle.
- The waiver column says whether the plan offers the dual-commodity waiver at all. The Monthly Index plan does not offer it, so its fee of $19.95 is billed for every billing cycle in which the site is supplied, whatever electricity the site takes from Beacon Ridge.
- The lowest fee, $9.95, belongs to the Fixed 36 plan; the Fixed Basis 12, Fixed 12 and Fixed 24 plans carry $14.95; the Monthly Index and Carbon Neutral 24 plans carry $19.95.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A site on the Fixed 24 plan, for a cycle in which the site holds no Beacon Ridge electricity agreement or contract, is billed the $14.95 fee for that cycle. The same site, for a cycle in which the waiver applies, is billed no fee line at all.
